decision: Retain the stored point as a conditional authoritative NPS access-area anchor. NPS establishes Hellems Beach as a public New River access, but the point is not a surveyed wet-toe coordinate, so the 573-foot flowline offset remains review-level evidence rather than a coordinate error.
